bridge.channelAllBotPreview: UI-only: Web composer preview of who an @all mention would wake
bridge.channelReadPosition: UI-only: Web unread divider position for one viewer
bridge.composerIdentity: UI-only: names the identity the Web composer shows; send already posts as the Host owner
bridge.composerValidate: UI-only: pre-send check for the Web composer's attachments and reply target; send runs the same Host checks
bridge.messageAttachmentTarget: UI-only: resolves a local file path so the Web UI can open or reveal an attachment in the OS
bridge.onboarding: UI-only: Web tutorial progress and steps
bridge.onboardingModel: UI-only: the Web tutorial's model step; model-preset-apply and model-plan configure models from the CLI
bridge.workspaceFileTarget: UI-only: resolves a Workspace folder path so the Web UI can open it in the OS; grants lists the paths

routes./api/computer/diagnostics/viewer: UI-only: the Web Client's Computer viewer reports its own connection events here; an agent reads them with computer-diagnostics
routes./api/remote.mux: UI-only: the Web Client's multiplexed WebSocket for live Browser and Computer streams; agents use browser-frame, browser-observation and computer-tool
